rule.vbs100.title: Script file could not be checked
rule.vbs100.rationale: The file has a VBScript file extension but could not be read. Check it manually – it most likely needs VBScript.
rule.vbs101.title: VBScript file (.vbs)
rule.vbs101.rationale: Windows runs .vbs files with the VBScript engine. Microsoft has deprecated VBScript: it is now a Windows feature on demand that is expected to be disabled by default in a later phase and removed after that. Without VBScript, the file no longer runs.
collector.banner: {product} Collector {version} – read-only scan for VBScript dependencies
collector.help:
Usage: {program} [options]

Scans this computer for VBScript dependencies and writes one result file.
Nothing on the computer is changed and no network connection is made.

Options:
  --out <file or folder>  Where to write the result file. Default: the current
                          folder, named <computer>_<date-time>.{extension}.
                          Existing files are never overwritten.
  --path <folder>         Scan only this local folder instead of all local
                          drives (repeatable).
  --include-unc <\\server\share\folder>
                          Also scan this network path, with the rights of the
                          running account (repeatable). Network paths are never
                          scanned otherwise.
  --files-only            Scan files only; skip the registry, scheduled tasks,
                          services, WMI and event logs.
  --lang <language>       Language of the console output (default: en):
                          {languages}.
  --quiet                 Print errors only.
  --help                  Show this help.
  --version               Show the version.

Run as administrator (or as SYSTEM through GPO, Intune or an RMM tool) for a
complete scan. Exit codes: 0 = result written, 1 = error, 2 = invalid options.
collector.limited: Not running as administrator: the scan is limited because protected locations cannot be read. The result file records this.
collector.done: Done in {seconds} s: {entries} entries examined, {findings} findings.
collector.error.outputExists: {path} already exists. {product} never overwrites files – choose another output path.
collector.error.outputDirMissing: The output folder {path} does not exist.
collector.error.systemFolder: The current folder {path} is a Windows system folder. Choose where to write the result with --out – for example a network share that collects all results.
collector.error.write: The result file {path} could not be written: {message}
collector.error.pathMissing: {path} does not exist or is not a folder.
collector.error.networkPath: {path} is a network path. Network locations are only scanned when given with --include-unc.
